claims.text: iTransformer outperforms prior transformer and RNN baselines on ETTh1, ETTh2, Traffic at horizon 336.
iTransformer is best characterised as inverted transformer treating variates as tokens.

evidence.description: Reported MSE reduction of 16% versus the strongest prior transformer on ETTh1 at horizon 336.

methodologies.name: iTransformer
methodologies.description: inverted transformer treating variates as tokens

limitations.text: Comparison omits linear baselines that recent work has shown to be competitive.
The training corpus is limited to a single domain, so cross-domain robustness is not established.

future_work.text: Analysing attention weights to test the interpretability hypothesis.
Reporting per-seed variance and confidence intervals for the headline metric.
